AboutPage.heroTitle: Jaise Pita hamke bhejis, waise hum tumke bhejta hai.
AboutPage.paragraph1: Apostolos Missions International (AM) ek antar-sampradaayik sewa kaam hai jon susamachaar ke dhartii ke chhor tak pahunchaay ke liye samarpit hai, aur Prabhu ke anant prem ke gawahi dewe hai.
AboutPage.paragraph2: (ἀπόστολος) Greek bhasa ke sabd hai jon ke matlab prerit hai. Iske matlab hai "jon ke mission par bheja gais hai" ya "sandeshvahak." "Prerit" ke upadhi Naya Niyam me barbar aawe hai jon Yeshu ke chunal Barah chela log ke darsaawe hai (Matti 10:2, Markus 3:14, Luka 6:13, Prerit 2:42). Paul, jon pahile Isai dharm ke satawe rahaa aur baad me susamachaar ke bara pracharak ban gais, apan ke "prerit" bataais (Romi 1:1, 1 Kurinthi 1:1, 2 Kurinthi 1:1, Galatiya 1:1, Kulussi 1:1, 1 Timothi 1:1, 2 Timothi 1:1, Titus).
AboutPage.paragraph3: Prerit log wahi hai jon ke Prabhu bhejis hai ki uu "Yeshu Masih ke prachaar kare aur Parmeshwar ke jaanay dewe" pura srishti ke. Preritai ke Bible ke aadhaar Prabhu ke bahut sab bachan me milta hai, jon pahila prerit log ke chunis aur unke waise bhejis jaise raajdut alag alag desh ke pratinidhitva kare ke bheja jaawe hai. Prerit log samjhta rahaa ki unkar jiwan sirf unkar naahi rahaa, balki uu ii girl duniya me Masih ke mahima dekhaay ke liye jiye rahaa.
AboutPage.blockquote: Yuhanna 20:21 me likha hai, "Yeshu phir se bolis, 'Tumhare upar shanti hoy! Jaise Pita hamke bhejis hai, waise hum bhi tumke bhejta hai.'" (NIV)
AboutPage.paragraph4: AM prerit log ke parampara ke maane chahta hai, jon Parmeshwar ke Bachan ke prachaar kare ke mission le ke jiye rahaa. Hum sab ke bhi Parmeshwar se ii bulaawa milta hai ki hum duniya me Unkar haath aur pair ban ke bheja jaay. Hum apan jiwan ke Yeshu ke pairhaan par chale aur dhartii ke chhor tak Susamachaar ke prachaar kare ke liye samarpit kare chahta hai.
AboutPage.paragraph5: Jaise Prabhu hamaar jiwan ke chhuis aur badlis, waise hum uu prem ke dekhaay chahta hai jon hamke mila, aur Unkar sab khoya hua bachcha log aur hamaar bhai bahin log ke liye ek ujiyaar ban jaay.

GetInvolvedHub.connectStep1Body: AM se jurne ke bahut raasta hai. Tum hamaar mukhya website, www.amintl.org, par naam likhaay ke newsletter paay sakta hai. Ya tum hamaar online Bible school ke website, www.amacademy.org, par naam likhaay ke naya khabar aur program paay sakta hai. Hamaar website par hamaar drishti, kaam aur program dekho aur jab bhi sawaal hoy hamke email karo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep2Title: 2. Hamaar Karmchari se Milay ke Naam Likhao
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep2BodySuffix: sakta hai iihaa agar tum hamaar kono karmchari se baat kare chahta hai aur apan aatmik yatra par salaah lena chahta hai. Tum bhent ke samay tay kar sakta hai ya hamaar karmchari se sampark kar sakta hai. Hamaar bahut karmchari campus jiwan me anubhav rakhta hai aur samjhta hai ki college ke chhatra log kaa jhelta hai. Uu tumke tumhaar biswas ke yatra ke liye sabse thik raasta khojay me madad karega.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3Title: 3. Bible Padhai ke Liye Naam Likhao
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodyPrefix: Agar tum hamaar Bible padhai ke program suru kare ke taiyaar hai,
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodySuffix: ii panna par. Agar tumke thik samay naahi milta, apan pasand ke course aur samay ke saath anurodh form bhejo!
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep4BodyPrefix: Agar tum hamaar sthaniya chapter ke daftar aur karmchari se jurna chahta hai, kripa kar ke
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep4BodySuffix: . Hum tumse jaldi milay ke intzaar me hai!
GetInvolvedHub.growIntro: Jaise hum bachpan ke alag alag charan me barhta aur sayana hota hai, waise hum apan aatmik pakkapan me bhi khaas manzil tak pahunchta hai. AM bahut sab program aur raasta dewe hai jon chhatra log ke aatmik barhotri ke ii tin jaruri charan me le jaay ke banal hai:
GetInvolvedHub.rebornBody: Hum Yeshu ke Krus par ke prayaschit balidaan se naya janm paata hai.
GetInvolvedHub.matureBody: Hum Yeshu se milal prem aur satya se pos ke aatmik roop se barhta aur sayana hota hai.
GetInvolvedHub.fruitfulBody: Hum Parmeshwar ke aashish se jiwan ke phal ke anubhav karta hai, jon Masih Yeshu ke saath hamaar sayana ekta me pura hota hai.
GetInvolvedHub.navigatingBody: Campus jiwan mazedaar aur santosh dewe wala hai, magar itna sab bikalp hone se, uu bina lakshya ke bhi lag sakta hai. Satya aur prarthana se, AM tumke Parmeshwar ke ichchha samajhay me aur tumhaar anokha jiwan ke liye saaf raasta khojay me madad karta hai.
GetInvolvedHub.nextStepsBody: Hamaar program me saamil hote raho—Bachan sune, saath prarthana kare, biswas ke bhai bahin log se sangati kare, aur Susamachaar me barhte hue sewa kare ke alag alag mauka ke faayda uthao.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep1Title: 1. Masih ke Prem me Sewa Karna
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep1Body: Jaise hum barhta hai, hum dusra log ke sewa kare chahta hai jinke Yeshu tak aay ke madad chahiye. Jaise hum sewa karta hai, hum bhi Masih ke prem me aur gahra barhta hai.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep2Body: Yeshu bolis, "Lene se dena jyada dhanya hai" (Prerit 20:35). Dusra log ke agua bane aur raasta dekhaay ke liye bidya, prarthana, balidaan aur dhiraj chahiye. Magar ii ek dhanya jagah hai jahaa Krus ke mahima apan chotii par pahunchta hai.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep3Body: College ke chhatra log abhi jawaan hai, magar netritva ke bhumika me unkar khaas bardaan aur hunar aur bhi jyada takat se khoja aur barhaya jaay sakta hai. Ii ek sundar raasta hai jahaa har chhatra sewa aur netritva ke anugrah bhara anubhav se apan swargiya bardaan ke parakhta aur pakka karta hai.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep4Body: AM chhatra log ke sewa aur netritva me saamil hone ke liye bahut sab mauka aur bhumika dewe hai. Hamaar sewak log, Chapter ke karmchari, Chapter ke agua, Bible master aur aur bahut ke team me saamil hoi. Khojo ki Yeshu apan sundar yojana ke anusaar tumhaar bhitar kaa bois hai.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph1: College se pass hona ek aur bara suruaat hai ek khula duniya ke taraf jon hamaar khojay ke liye hai. Hum me se kuchh log aur padhai kare sakta hai ya naukari ke raasta le sakta hai. Hum me se kuchh log AM ke pura samay ke karmchari, missionary ya sewak ban jaawe hai jon Parmeshwar ke bulaawa ke maanta hai.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph2: Ii jaruri kadam me, AM aisa program dewe hai jisme tum jura rah sakta hai aur Alumni Connect ke jariye Susamachaar ke mission me sewa karta rah sakta hai. AM AM World Mission me pesewar mission karmi aur karmchari bane ke liye training program aur raasta bhi dewe hai.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph3: Tumhaar liye ek ujjwal bhavishya ke taraf bahut sab bikalp khula hai. AM har ek insaan ke saath lage lage chale chahta hai taaki hum sab ke Maha Aadesh ke liye ek saath laay sake, "Islie jaao, sab jaati ke chela banao, aur unke Pita, Putra aur Pawitra Aatma ke naam me baptisma do (Matti 28:19)."

BibleStudyProgram.eyebrow: Hamaar Bible Padhai ke Program me Saamil Hoi
BibleStudyProgram.heading: Pahila sawaal se lekar bheja jaay tak ke 5 charan ke raasta.
BibleStudyProgram.description: AM ke 5 charan ke Bible Padhai ke Program ek online chela banaay aur Bible sikhaay ke program hai jon chhatra log ke Yeshu Masih ke Susamachaar aur biswas ke jiwan sikhay ke ek kramik raasta par le jaawe hai. Ii program chhatra log ke Bible master log ke saath rakhta hai jon sunay wala ke samay ke hisaab se sikhaawe hai. Iske ant me sewa kare, chhatra missionary ke roop me training lene, ya AM ke saath Parmeshwar ke Bachan me aur gahra jaay ke mauka milta hai.
